senses.gloss: व्यतीत व्यतीत. 1. Passed, Chr. 16, 20. 2. Dead, MBh. 1, 4592.
व्याघ्रचर्म-मय व्याघ्रचर्म-मय, i. e. व्याघ्र-चर्मन् + मय, covered by a sheath made of the hide of a tiger, MBh. 6, 1787.
व्याकुल- + चेतस् व्याकुल- + चेतस्, adj. bewildered.
व्यंसक व्यंसक, i. e. वि-अंस् + अक, m. A cheat, a rogue, a juggler.

व्यक्ति व्यक्ति, i. e. वि-अञ्ज् + ती, f.
 1. Distinctness, Śāk. d. 167.
 2. Individuality.
 3. An individual (opp. to जाति), Siddh. Mukt. 82, 10.
 4. Appearance, manifestation Bhag. 7, 23; 10, 14; Megh. 12.
 --Comp.

व्यग्र व्यग्र, i. e. वि-अग्र, adj., f. रा,
 1. Bewildered, Hit. iii. d. 108 (भोजन-, by the care for provisions).
 2. Distracted.
 3. Agitated, Pañc. 200, 8.
 4. Engaged in, Vikr. 77, 4; occupied, Pañc. 121, 14; zealously occupied, Pañc. iii. d. 236; zealous, eager, Rājat. 5, 144.
 --Comp.
व्यग्रता व्यग्र + ता, f. Zealous occupation, Pañc. 252, 24.
व्यग्रत्व व्यग्र + त्व, n. Perplexedness, confusion, Pañc. iii. d. 128.

व्यङ्ग व्यङ्ग, i. e. वि-अङ्ग,
 I. adj.
 1. Deformed, mutilated, MBh. 1, 1089.
 2. Lamed.
 3. Bodiless.
 4. Ill-arranged.
 II. m.
 1. A cripple.
 2. A frog.
 3. Discoloration of the face, dark spots on the cheek.
 --Comp.
व्यङ्गता व्यङ्ग + ता, f. Mutilation, Pañc. i. d. 217.
व्यङ्गय व्यङ्गय, a denomin. derived from व्यङ्ग, Par. To mutilate, Pañc. 38, 13; 40, 25.
व्यङ्गार व्यङ्गार, i. e. वि-अङ्गार, adj. [] Without charcoal. n. loc. रे, At the time when the burning charcoal is extinguished, Man. 6, 56.

व्यच् व्यच् (i. e. वि-अञ्च्), i. 6, विच, Par.
 1. To surround, to encompass (ved.).
 2. † To deceive.
व्यज व्यज, i. e. वि-अज् + अ, m. A fan, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 3322.

व्याज व्याज, i. e. वि-अञ्ज् + अ, m.
 1. Deceit, fraud, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 396; Pañc. 147, 15.
 2. Disguise either of purpose or person.
 3. Appearance, Pañc. iii. d. 125; pretence, Daśak. in Chr. 186, 2.
 4. Means, Pañc. 75, 24; 118, 3.
 5. Wickedness.
 --Comp.

व्यजन व्यजन, i. e. वि-अज् + अन, n. A fan, Hit. ii. d. 155; Bhāg. P. 3, 23, 16.
 --Comp.

व्यञ्जक व्यञ्जक, i. e. वि-अञ्ज् + अक,
 I. adj. Clearly showing, Man. 2, 68.
 II. m.
 1. A mark.
 2. External indication of passion or feeling.
 3. Feeling, Mālat. 154, 6.

व्यञ्जन व्यञ्जन, i. e. वि-अञ्ज् + अन,
 I. n.
 1. A mark, a sign, Hit. iii. d. 36; the marks of puberty (hairs of the body), Pañc. iii. d. 214 (pl.).
 2. Paraphernalia, insignia.
 3. A beard, Brāhmaṇav. 1, 28.
 4. A privy part, either male or female.
 5. Sauce, Rām. 1, 13, 15; condiment, Pañc. 52, 1.
 6. A consonant, Sāv. 5, 25.
 II. n., and f. ना, Irony, sarcasm.
 III. f. ना, The third power of a word, suggestion, Sāh. Darp. 16, 20.
 --Comp.

व्यतिकर व्यतिकर, i. e. वि-अति-कृ + अ,
 I. adj.
 1. Reciprocal, or acting one with another.
 2. Pervading.
 3. Contiguous to.
 II. m.
 1. Reciprocity, exchange, Daśak. in Chr. 184, 16; interchange, Mālat. 34, 11; reciprocal action, ib. 199, 16; relation, alternation, Utt. Rāmac. 125, 11.
 2. Action in [] general, Pañc. 30, 8; 237, 22; 130,
 3. Contact, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 429; contiguity.
 4. Opportunity, Pañc. 40, 18.
 5. Mixture, Megh. 15; union, Utt. Rāmac. 84, 2 (at the end of a comp. adj. ‘united’); conflux, Ragh. 8, 94.
 6. Misfortune, calamity, Pañc. 42, 5.
 --Comp.
व्यतिकरित व्यतिकरित, i. e. व्यतिकर + इत, adj. Pervaded, Mālat. 40, 1.

व्यतिक्रम व्यतिक्रम, i. e. वि-अति-क्रम् + अ, m.
 1. Inverted or retrograde order, reverse, Kir. 11, 76.
 2. Contrariety.
 3. Misfortune.
 4. Passing over or beyond, transgression, Man. 8, 244; Pañc. 46, 20.
 5. Fault, Man. 8, 229; sin, Rām. 1, 8, 12.
 6. Non-performance (as of contracts), 8, 5.

व्यतिरेक व्यतिरेक, i. e. वि-अति-रिच् + अ, m.
 1. Separateness.
 2. Negative inference, Bhāṣāp. 141.
 3. Interception, Mālat. 140, 20.
 4. Difference.
 5. Dissimilitude of things compared in some respects to each other.
 6. Exclusion, exception.
व्यतिलङ्घिन् व्यतिलङ्घिन्, i. e. वि-अति-लङ्घ् + अ + इन्, adj. Removed, Ragh. 6, 19.

व्यतिषङ्ग व्यतिषङ्ग, i. e. वि-अति-सञ्ज् + अ, m.
 1. Mutual or reciprocal junction.
 2. Fastening, tying together.

व्यतिहार and व्यतीहार व्यती̆हार, i. e. वि-अति-हृ + अ, m.
 1. Barter, exchange.
 2. Exchange of blows or abuse.
व्यतीहार व्यतीहार, see व्यतिहार.

व्यतीपात व्यतीपात, i. e. वि-अति-पत् + अ, m.
 1. Disrespect.
 2. A portent indicating calamity.
 3. Great calamity.
 4. Day of new moon, falling on a Sunday, and the moon being in certain [] mansions.
 5. The seventeenth of the astrological Yogas.

व्यत्यय व्यत्यय, i. e. वि-अति-इ + अ, m.
 1. Inverted or retrograde order.
 2. Contrariety, reverse.
 3. Interchange, Pāṇ. iii. 1, 85.

व्यत्यास व्यत्यास, i. e. वि-अति- 2. अस् + अ, m.
 1. Inverted or retrograde order.
 2. Reversed position.
 3. Contrariety, reverse.

व्यथ् व्यथ्, i. 1, Ātm. (in epic poetry also Par., MBh. 4, 1453),
 1. To tremble, MBh. 8, 4693.
 2. To be disquieted or afflicted, MBh. 2, 1801.
 3. To fear, MBh. 3, 717.
 4. To suffer pain, ib. 3, 2675.
 5. To dry (Sch.), Man. 7, 84.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. व्यथित.
 1. Alarmed, frightened, Rām. 3, 53, 61.
 2. Afflicted, Ṛt. 6, 18.
 3. Disturbed, Kir. 5, 11; Daśak. in Chr. 193, 1 (changed).
 4. Pained, Pañc. 69, 2.
 --Caus.
 1. To make uneasy, Bhag. 2, 15; to afflict, Pañc. ii. d. 103.
 2. To frighten, MBh. 3, 16418.
 3. To lead away from, Bhaṭṭ. 10, 36.
 --With the prep. प्र प्र,
 1. To be afflicted, Rām. 2, 18, 41.
 2. To be frightened, Bhag. 11, 20; to fear (or to tremble), with gen., MBh. 5, 4564. प्रव्यथित, Very anxious, Daśak. in Chr. 194, 7.
 --With संप्र सम्प्र, संप्रव्यथित, Frightened, Rām. 1, 38, 16.
 --Cf. Goth. vithon, To shake; probably ὄθη, ὄθομαι, ὠθέω, ἐνοσί-χθων, ἔννοσις.

व्यथक व्यथ् + अक, adj.
 1. Inflicting pain.
 2. Distressing, afflicting, Kir. 2, 4.

व्यथा व्यथ् + आ, f.
 1. Alarm, fear, Utt. Rāmac. 9, 6.
 2. Distress, Pañc. 215, 19.
 3. Pain, Pañc. iv. d. 19; [] disease, Pañc. v. d. 66.
 --Comp.

व्यध् व्यध्, i. 4, विध्य, Par.
 1. To pierce, Chr. 292, 9 = Rigv. i. 86, 9 (ved. विध्यता, with lengthened final).
 2. To hit, Johns. Sel. 39, 31 (वेद्धा, anomal. first fut.).
 3. To wave in triumph, Johns. Sel. 52, 115 (anomal. red. pf. विव्यधुस्).
 4. To pick, Pañc. 62, 9; to wound, Man. 8, 12.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. विद्ध.
 1. Wounded, Chr. 31, 16.
 2. Thrown, Man. 9, 43.
 3. Beaten, whipped.
 4. Opposed, impeded.
 5. Resembling, like. n. A wound, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 2647.
 --Comp.
 --With the prep. अति अति, अति-विद्ध, Pierced, transfixed, Rām. 2, 9, 51.
 --With अनु अनु, To throw after (another), Man. 9, 43. अनुविद्ध,
 1. Wounded, Ṛt. 1, 13.
 2. Obstructed, Śāk. d. 19; checked.
 3. Mixed, Mālat. 15, 13.
 4. Ornamented, Megh. 66; variegated.
 5. Set (as a jewel).
 6. Full of, abounding.
 --With अप अप,
 1. To throw away, MBh. 3, 15686.
 2. To omit, to neglect, Man. 11, 4. अप-विद्ध,
 1. Thrown away, Daśak. in Chr. 193, 21.
 2. Discarded, Kir. 5, 30 (by churning).
 3. (viz. पुत्र, A son), who having been disowned by his parents, is adopted by another, Man. 9, 159.
 4. Contemptible.
 5. Disabled, broken, literally and figuratively.
 --With व्यप वि-अप, व्यपविद्ध, Rejected, MBh. 3, 15763.
 --With आ आ, [] To throw, MBh. 3, 11511. आविद्ध,
 1. Thrown, Man. 9, 43.
 2. Pierced, wounded.
 3. Crooked, Vikr. d. 115.
 4. Disappointed.
 5. Stupid.
 --Comp.
 --With व्या वि-आ, To vibrate, MBh. 3, 677. व्याविद्ध, Dishevelled, Daśak. in Chr. 199, 1.
 --With समा सम्-आ, To vibrate, Ragh. 26, 78 (Calc.).
 --With उद् उद्, उद्विद्ध, Lofty, Lass. 2. ed. 72, 5.
 --With निस् निस्, निर्विद्ध, Wounded, Rām. 3, 50, 19.
 --With परि परि, To wound, MBh. 1, 4102.
 --With प्र प्र, To throw away, Rām. 2, 63, 34.
 --With विप्र वि-प्र, To strike, Ragh. 14, 54.
 --With प्रति प्रति, To wound, MBh. 3, 11960.
 --Cf. perhaps ϝεθ in ἄεθλος.
व्यध्व व्यध्व, i. e. वि-अध्वन्, m. A bad road.

व्यध व्यध् + अ,
 I. m.
 1. Piercing, Kāvya Prak. 100, 9.
 2. Striking.
 II. f. धा, Bleeding, Suśr. 1, 362, 5.

व्याध व्याध, i. e. व्यध् + अ, m.
 1. A hunter, Pañc. 147, 11.
 2. A low or wicked man.
 --Comp.
व्यन्तर व्यन्तर, i. e. वि-अन्तर, m. A deity (haunting in a tree), Pañc. 250, 2.
व्यप् व्यप्, see विप्.
व्यपत्रप व्यपत्रप, i. e. वि-अप-त्रप, adj. Shameless, Rām. 2, 68, 17, ed. Seramp.

व्यपदेश व्यपदेश, i. e. वि-अप-दिश् + अ, m.
 1. Information.
 2. Name, appellation, Bhāṣāp. 46.
 3. Race, Śāk. 104, 6.
 4. Renown, Man. 7, 168.
 5. Pretext, Pañc. iii. d. 79 (महताम्, Pretending [the authority of] powerful men).
 6. Hint.
 7. Craft.
 8. Stratagem.

व्यपरोपण व्यपरोपण, i. e. वि-अप-रुह्, Caus., + अन, n.
 1. Extirpating, expelling.
 2. Cutting, Ragh. 3, 56.
व्यपाकृति व्यपाकृति, i. e. वि-अप-आ-कृ + ति, n. Repelling, denial.
व्यपाय व्यपाय, i. e. वि-अप-इ + अ, m. End, Ragh. 3, 3.

व्यपाश्रय व्यपाश्रय, i. e. वि-अप-आ-शृ + अ, m.
 1. Taking refuge with, Bhag. 18, 56; relying upon.
 2. Expectation.

व्यपेक्षा व्यपेक्षा, i. e. वि-अप-ईक्ष् + अ, f.
 1. Mutual connexion.
 2. Regard, Chr. 43, 24 (corr. thus); expectation.
 --Comp.

व्यभिचार व्यभिचार, i. e. वि-अभि-चार् + अ, m.
 1. Going astray, erring (literally and figurat.)
 2. The presence of the हेतु without the साध्य, Bhāṣāp. 136.
 3. Following improper courses.
 4. Crime, vice, sin, Hit. iii. d. 16; MBh. 1, 912.
 5. Infidelity of a wife, Man. 10, 164.
 --Comp.
व्यभिचारतस् व्यभिचार + तस्, adv. From the व्यभिचार, involved in the other supposition, Bhāṣāp. 47.
व्यभिचारिता व्यभिचारिता, i. e. व्यभिचारिन् + ता, f. Error, Bhāṣāp. 138.

व्यभिचारित्व व्यभिचारित्व, i. e. व्यभिचारिन् + त्व, n. Doubt.
 --Comp.

व्यभिचारिन् व्यभिचारिन्, i. e. वि-अभि-चर् and र्यभिचार + इन्,
 I. adj., f. इणी.
 1. Going astray, wanton, Hit. pr. d. 21, M.M.
 2. Doing what is improper.
 II. f. इणी, A wanton woman, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 507.
 --Comp.
व्यभ्र व्यभ्र, i. e. वि-अभ्र, adj. Cloudless, Nal. 17, 11.

व्यय् व्यय्, i. 1, Ātm. (a denomin. from व्यय), To squander away, Hit. ii. d. 91.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. व्ययित,
 1. Expended, Hit. 98, 17.
 2. Dissipated, Hit. 60, 10.
 3. Fallen to decay.
 --† i. 10, Par. To throw.

व्यय व्यय, i. e. वि-इ + अ,
 I. adj. Mutable, Man. 1, 19.
 II. m.
 1. Disappearance, loss, Lass. 59, 1; Pañc. i. d. 179; Mālat. 70, 14 (risk).
 2. Destruction, Ragh. 5, 5; Daśak. in Chr. 181, 5 (detriment).
 3. Expenditure, expense, Man. 8, 287; Pañc. 138, 4.
 4. Squandering away, Lass. 75, 13.
 5. Misfortune, decline.
 --Comp.
ऽव्ययिन् -व्ययिन्, i. e. व्यय + इन्, adj. in उदय-, Mounting and falling, Hit. iii. d. 128.

व्यर्थ व्यर्थ, i. e. वि-अर्थ, adj.
 1. Useless, unprofitable, Pañc. i. d. 445; Hit. i. d. 129, M.M.; Pañc. 134, 14.
 2. Unmeaning.

व्यर्थता व्यर्थ + ता, f.
 1. Uselessness, with या or गम्, To become useless, Pañc. 128, 1. 215, 22.
 2. Inoffensiveness, Pañc. 169, 14.
 3. Nonsense.

व्यलीक व्यलीक (cf. अलीक),
 I. adj.
 1. Disagreeable, offensive.
 2. Improper.
 3. Painful.
 4. Strange.
 II. m. A catamite.
 III. n.
 1. Any displeasing or improper act.
 2. Disagreeableness.
 3. Pain, grief, Śāk. d. 183; Pañc. i. d. 272.
 4. Fault, transgression, Śiś. 9, 85; Hit. ii. d. 125.
 5. Cheating, falsehood, Pañc. i. d. 136 (cf. Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 3208).
 --Comp.[]

व्यवक्रोशन व्यवक्रोशन, i. e. वि-अव-क्रुश् + अन, n.
 1. Altercation.
 2. Abuse.

व्यवच्छेद व्यवच्छेद, i. e. वि-अव-छिद् + अ, m.
 1. Dividing.
 2. A division.
 3. Discrimination.
 4. Distinction, contrast.
 5. Letting fly an arrow, shooting.
 6. Cutting in pieces.

व्यवधा व्यवधा, i. e. वि-अव-धा, f.
 1. A covering, a screen.
 2. Being covered, disappearance.

व्यवधान व्यवधान, i. e. वि-अव-धा + अन, n.
 1. Intervening, Ragh. 13, 44.
 2. Separation, Śiś. 9, 51.
 3. Covering, a cover, Śāk. 92, 13 (Prākṛ.).
 4. Being covered, disappearance.

व्यवधायक व्यवधायक, i. e. वि-अव-धा + अक, adj.
 1. Intervening.
 2. Separating.
 3. Screening, hiding.
व्यवधि व्यवधि, i. e. वि-अव-धा (cf. निधि), m. Covering, or a covering.

व्यवसाय व्यवसाय, i. e. वि-अव-सो + अ, m.
 1. Perseverance, Pañc. iii. d. 264; eagerness.
 2. Exertion, effort, Pañc. 215, 22; energy, Pañc. 134, 10; cf. 138, 7; i. d. 195 (येषां व्यवसायनिश्चयः, Who are resolved to endeavour).
 3. Following any business or profession.
 4. Resolve, determination, Brāhmaṇav. 2, 32.
 5. Obstinacy, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 412.
 6. Plan, device, trick, Hit. ii. d. 113 (or, perseverance).
 7. Boasting.

व्यवसायिन् व्यवसायिन्, i. e. व्यवसाय + इन्, adj.
 1. Persevering.
 2. Active, energetic, Hit. ii. d. 11; willing, [] Pañc. 134, 10; cf. 138, 7; undertaking, resolute, Pañc. i. d. 278.
 3. Engaged in business.
 4. Performing one's duty, Man. 12, 103.
 --Comp.

व्यवस्था व्यवस्था, i. e. वि-अव-स्था, f.
 1. Separating, placing remote or apart.
 2. Placing.
 3. Staying.
 4. State, course, Rājat. 5, 80.
 5. A decree, a written declaration of the law, decision, Rājat. 5, 461.
 6. An engagement, a contract.
 --Comp.
व्यवस्थापक व्यवस्थापक, i. e. वि-अव-स्था, Caus., + अक, adj. Deciding, Rājat. 6, 54 (दुस्-, adj. Deciding wrongly).

व्यवस्थापन व्यवस्थापन, i. e. वि-अव-स्था, Caus., + अन, n.
 1. Placing apart.
 2. Placing.
 3. Fixing.
 4. Appointing.
 5. Deciding.
 6. Declaring.

व्यवस्थिति व्यवस्थिति, i. e. वि-अव-स्था + ति, f.
 1. Constancy, perseverance, Bhag. 16, 1.
 2. Determining.
 3. Rule, Man. 10, 70.
 4. Extracting.

व्यवहर्तृ व्यवहर्तृ, i. e. वि-अव-हृ + तृ,
 I. m., f. त्री, and n.
 1. Transacting business, engaged in affairs.
 2. Observing established usages.
 II. m.
 1. A judge.
 2. A litigant, a plaintiff.
 3. Partaker, associate.

व्यवहार व्यवहार, i. e. वि-अव-हृ + अ, m.
 1. Doing, performing, Bhāṣāp. 105 (गणन-, Numbering); Lass. 76, 9; occupation, Śāk. 104, 23; action, Mālat. 70, 6.
 2. Affair, Utt. Rāmac. 127, 3 (नास्य व्यवहारो स्त्रेस्हु, He has nothing with weapons); Man. 8, 420.
 3. Profession, business, Pañc. i. d. 91.
 4. Pecuniary transaction, Man. 3, 64; usury, Pañc. i. d. 12.
 5. Petty traffic, Man. 7, 137; trade, Pañc. 7, 17.
 6. Usage, custom, Hit. 58, 18.
 7. [] Conduct, Hit. i. d. 57; 70, M.M.
 8. Practice of the courts, or civil and criminal law, Man. 8, 148; judicial proceeding, Man. 8, 1.
 9. Administration of justice, Journ. of the German Oriental Society, vii. 528.
 10. Any acts cognisable in courts.
 11. An occurrence which must be inquired, an important affair, Pañc. 45, 13.
 12. Lawsuit, Pañc. 165, 4.
 13. A contract.
 --Comp.

व्यवहारक व्यवहारक i. e. वि-अव-हृ + अक,
 I. m. A trader, Pañc. 138, 15.
 II. f. रिका.
 1. Usage.
 2. A brush.
व्यवहारज्ञ व्यवहार-ज्ञ, m. A young man of age.
व्यवहारवन्त् व्यवहार + वन्त्, adj. Occupied, working with, Man. 10, 37.

व्यवहारिक व्यवहारिक, i. e. व्यवहार + इक, adj.
 1. Customary.
 2. Relating to legal process.
 3. Litigant.

व्यावहारिक व्यावहारिक, i. e. व्यवहार + इक,
 I. adj.
 1. Active, Vedāntas. in Chr. 207, 6.
 2. Usual, customary.
 3. Judicial, relating to trials, Man. 8, 78.
 II. m. A counseller, Rām. 2, 51, 13, ed. Seramp. (thus to be read).
 III. n. Use, Man. 8, 164.

व्यवाय व्यवाय, i. e. वि-अव-इ + अ,
 I. m.
 1. Copulation, Rājat. 5, 280.
 2. Intervening, interval.
 3. Covering, disappearance.
 II. n. Light, lustre.
व्यवायिन् व्यवायिन्, i. e. व्यवाय + इन्, adj. sbst. Lecherous, a lecher.
व्यश्व व्यश्व, i. e. वि-अश्व, adj. Having no horse, Chr. 297, 15 = Rigv. i. 112, 15.
व्यष्टि व्यष्टि, i. e. वि-अक्ष् + ति, f. Singleness, individuality, Vedāntas. in Chr. 204, 13.

व्यसन व्यसन, i. e. वि-अस् + अन, n.
 1. Calamity, misfortune, Vikr. 59, 1; Pañc. ii. d. 13; destruction, Mālat. 154, 13; loss, Kir. 13, 15.
 2. Fate.
 3. Ill luck.
 4. Fruitless effort, Bhartṛ. 2, 96 (pl.).
 5. Inability, incompetence (see the next).
 6. Fault, vice, Man. 7, 45; [] Hit. pr. d. 48, M.M.; crime.
 7. Sin, Śāk. d. 38.
 8. Intent application or attachment to an object, Pañc. i. d. 314; diligence, Hit. i. d. 31, M.M.
 9. Individuality.
 --Comp.

व्यसनिता व्यसनिता, f., and व्यसनित्व व्यसनित्व, n., i. e. व्यसनिन् + ता, or त्व,
 1. Wickedness, Rājat. 5, 255 (त्व); Hit. 94, 3 (ता, instr. Wrongly).
 2. Calamity.

व्यसनिन् व्यसनिन्, i. e. व्यसन + इन्, adj.
 1. Wicked, Pañc. v. d. 17; vicious, Man. 7, 53; Pañc. 163, 14; ruled by passions, Kathās. 26, 199.
 2. Unfortunate, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 814; being in distress, Hit. iii. d. 34; afflicted, Hit. iv. d. 44 (दुर्भिक्ष-, by the calamity of famine).
 3. Intent on, Bhartṛ. 2, 100.
 4. Occupied, Pañc. 192, 3.
 --Comp.
व्यसु व्यसु, i. e. वि-असु, adj. Lifeless, Rājat. 5, 241.

व्याकरण व्याकरण, i. e. वि-आ-कृ + अन, n.
 1. Explaining.
 2. Grammar, Pañc. 4, 14; ii. d. 34.
 --Comp.

व्याकुल व्याकुल, i. e. वि-आकुल, adj.
 1. Confounded, bewildered, Pañc. 9, 13; 144, 4; Hit. iii. d. 110.
 2. Trembling, [] Utt. Rāmac. 83, 5.
 3. Dimmed, Chr. 17, 25.
 4. Occupied, Megh. 83.

व्याकुलता व्याकुल + ता, f., and व्याकुलत्व व्याकुल + त्व, n. Perplexity, Pañc. 143, 4 (ता); agitation, 58, 3 (ता); fear, ib. 76, 12 (त्व).
 --Comp.

व्याकुलय व्याकुलय, a denomin. derived from व्याकुल, Par. To frighten, Pañc. 89, 14.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. व्याकुलित (or व्याकुल + इत), Agitated, alarmed, Pañc. 222, 8; perplexed, Pañc. 142, 14.

व्याकृति व्याकृति, i. e. वि-आ-कृ + ति, f.
 1. Explaining.
 2. Grammar.
 3. Change of form, development, Suśr. 1, 9, 10.
व्याकोश व्याकोश, and व्याकोष व्याकोष, i. e. वि-आ-कोश, adj. Budded.
व्याक्षेप व्याक्षेप, i. e. वि-आ-क्षिप् + अ, m. Delay; in अ-, m. Absence of delay, Ragh. 10, 6.
व्याख्या व्याख्या, i. e. वि-आ-ख्या, f. Exposition, comment.
व्याख्यातृ व्याख्यातृ, i. e. वि-आ-ख्या + तृ, m. An expounder, Rājat. 5, 29.
व्याख्यान व्याख्यान, i. e. वि-आ-ख्या + अन, n. Explaining.

व्याघट्टन व्याघट्टन, i. e. वि-आ-घट्ट् + अन, n.
 1. Rubbing.
 2. Churning.

व्याघात व्याघात, i. e. वि-आ-हन्, Caus., + अ, m.
 1. Obstacle, Hit. ii. d. 4.
 2. Striking.
 3. Wounding, Indr. 5, 11.
 4. Destroying.
 5. The thirteenth of the astronomical Yogas.

व्याघ्र व्याघ्र, i. e. वि-आ-घ्रा,
 I. m.
 1. A tiger, Pañc. 157, 25.
 2. As latter part of comp. words, Best, preeminent, e. g. पुरुष-, m. An eminent [] man (literally, A tiger-like man), Rām. 3, 53, 19.
 II. f. घ्री, The female of a tiger, Bhartṛ. 3, 39.
 --Comp.

व्याड व्याड, m.
 1. A snake.
 2. A beast of prey.
 3. A rogue.
 4. Indra (cf. व्याल).
व्याडि व्याडि, m. The name of a grammarian, Kathās. 4, 108.
व्यादान व्यादान, i. e. वि-आ-दा + अन, n. Opening, setting ajar, Hit. 85, 8.
व्यादित व्यादित, see दा with वि-आ.
व्यादीर्घ व्यादीर्घ, i. e. वि-आ-दीर्घ, adj. Long, Bhartṛ. 1, 86.
व्याधाम व्याधाम, i. e. वि-आ-धमा + अ (from धम्), m. Indra's thunderbolt.
व्याधाय व्याधाय, a denomin. derived from व्याध with य, Ātm. To become a hunter, Śṛṅgārat. 13.

व्याधि व्याधि, i. e. व्यध् + इ, m.
 1. Pain, Mālat. 69, 5.
 2. Sickness, Hit. i. d. 3, M.M.
 --Comp.
व्याधित व्याधित, i. e. व्याधि + इत, adj. Afflicted with disease, Man. 4, 157; 8, 395; sick, Hit. i. d. 201, M.M.
व्याधिन् व्याधिन्, i. e. व्याध + इन्, adj. Frequented by hunters, Nalod. 3, 35.
व्यान व्यान, i. e. वि-अन् + अ, m. One of the five vital airs, that which is diffused throughout the body, Vedāntas. in Chr. 207, 11.

व्यापक व्यापक, i. e. वि-आप् + अक,
 I. adj.
 1. Diffusive.
 2. Extensive.
 II. m. A pervading attribute, one always found where some other is found, Bhāṣāp. 137.

व्यापकत्व व्यापक + त्व, n.
 1. Diffusion, pervadence.
 2. State of being more extensive, Bhāṣāp. 9, cf. 142.
व्यापत्ति व्यापत्ति, i. e. वि-आ-पद् + ति, f. Ruin, Pañc. i. d. 316.

व्यापद् व्यापद्, i. e. वि-आ-पद्, f.
 1. Calamity, Hit. 95, 1, M.M. (at the end of a comp. adj. त्यक्त-, vb. त्यज्, Free from calamity).
 2. Derangement.
 3. Disease.
 4. Death, Megh. 111.
 --Comp.
व्यापाद व्यापाद, i. e. वि-आ-पद् + अ, m. The wish or project to injure another person.

व्यापादन व्यापादन, i. e. वि-आ-पद्, Caus., + अन, n.
 1. Killing, Pañc. 265, 16 (सर्प-, Being killed by the snake).
 2. Wishing to injure another person.
व्यापादनीयता व्यापादनीय + ता [] (vb. पद्), f. Necessity of being killed, Pañc. 143, 25.

व्यापार व्यापार, i. e. वि-आ- 2. पृ + अ, m.
 1. Occupation, Vedāntas. in Chr. 202, 18; doing, Pañc. 162, 8; business, 262, 7; Vikr. d. 58 (व्यापारं व्रजसि शरीरे, You have to do with my body, i. e. you command over my body).
 2. Work, Śāk. d. 26; Bhāṣāp. 58; 79.
 3. Affair, Pañc. 57, 8.
 4. Trade (cf. व्रज्), profession.
 5. Exercise, practice, exertion, Hit. pr. d. 43, M.M.; activity, Mālat. 10, 11.
 --Comp.
व्यापित्व व्यापित्व, i. e. व्यापिन् + त्व, n. The state of pervading, Vedāntas. in Chr. 205, 3.

व्यापिन् व्यापिन्, i. e. वि-आप् + इन्,
 I. adj.
 1. Diffusive.
 2. Comprehensive.
 3. Pervading, Bhāṣāp. 42.
 4. Filling, Kir. 5, 18.
 5. Extending to, Śāk. d. 170.
 II. m. The pervading property or power.

व्याप्ति व्याप्ति, i. e. वि-आप् + ति, f.
 1. Pervading, Vedāntas. in Chr. 215, 18.
 2. Universal permeation, omnipresence.
 3. Inherence, the inherent and essential presence of any thing or property in another, as heat in fire, oil in the sesamum seed.
 4. The relation of a subject (व्याप्त, व्याप्य) to a predicate (व्यापक) in an universal proposition, Bhāṣāp. 65; 67; 68; 136.

व्याप्तिमन्त् व्याप्ति + मन्त्, adj., f. [] मती,
 1. Pervading, diffusive.
 2. Pervaded, attended by, Man. 12, 26.

व्याप्यत्व व्याप्य + त्व (vb. आप् with वि), n.
 1. Capacity of being pervaded, or of obtaining, Vedāntas. in Chr. 215, 15.
 2. State of being less extensive, Bhāṣāp. 9.

व्याम व्याम, i. e. वि-यम् + अ, m.
 1. A fathom, or the space between the tips of the fingers of either hand when the arms are extended, Daśak. in Chr. 197, 17; MBh. 3, 10207.
 2. Smoke.

व्यामर्ष व्यामर्ष, i. e. वि-आ-मृष् + अ, m.
 1. Erasure (vb. मृश्?).
 2. Impatience.
व्यामिश्र व्यामिश्र, i. e. वि-आ-मिश्र (q. cf.), adj. Mixed, blended, confounded, Bhag. 3, 2.
व्यामोह व्यामोह, i. e. वि-आ-मुह् + अ, m. Error, foolishness, Prab. 76, 9.
व्यायतत्व व्यायतत्व, i. e. वि-आ-यत (vb. यम्), + त्व, n. Firmness, Śāk. d. 37.

व्यायाम व्यायाम, i. e. वि-आ-यम् + अ, m.
 1. Athletic exercise.
 2. Exertion, fighting, Arj. 3, 40.
 3. Manhood, manliness, MBh. 13, 542.
 4. Occupation, business.
 5. A difficulty.
 6. Fatigue, labour, Sāv. 5, 2.
 7. A fathom (see व्याम).

व्यायामिन् व्यायामिन्, i. e. व्यायाम + इन्, adj.
 1. Athletic.
 2. Active.
 3. Undergoing fatigue.

व्याल व्याल,
 I. adj.
 1. Wicked, Kir. 17, 25.
 2. Cruel.
 II. m.
 1. A snake, Hit. iii. d. 30.
 2. A beast of prey, Pañc. i. d. 420.
 3. A vicious elephant, Bhartṛ. 2, 6.
 4. A rogue.
 5. A king.
 III. f. ली, A female snake, Chr. 22, 22.
व्यालग्राहिन् व्याल-ग्राहिन्, m. A serpent-catcher, Hit. iii. d. 30.
व्यालोल व्यालोल, i. e. वि-आ-लुल् + अ, adj. Tremulous, shaking, Rājat. 5, 372. Cf. the next.
व्यालोलकुन्तलकलापवन्त् व्यालोल-कुन्तल-कलाप + वन्त्, adj., f. वती, With dishevelled hair, Caur. 7.
व्यावक्रोशी व्यावक्रोशी, i. e. वि-आ-अव-क्रुश् + अ + ई, f. Mutual imprecation.
व्यावभाषी व्यावभाषी, i. e. वि-आ-अव-भाष् + अ + ई, f. Mutual abuse or imprecation.

व्यावर्त व्यावर्त, i. e. वि-वा-वृत् + अ, m.
 1. Going round, revolving.
 2. Encompassing.
 3. Choosing, appointing.
व्यावर्तकता व्यावर्तकता, i. e. वि-आ-वृत् + अक + ता, f. Excluding, Vedāntas. in Chr. 213, 18.

व्यावर्तन व्यावर्तन, i. e. वि-आ-वृत् + अन, n.
 1. Rolling round.
 2. A volute, Kir. 5, 30.
 3. A band.
 4. Encompassing.

व्यावृति व्यावृति, i. e. वि-आ-वृ + ति, f.
 1. Covering, screening.
 2. Exclusion, exception (? see the next).

व्यावृत्ति व्यावृत्ति, i. e. वि-आ-वृत् + ति, f.
 1. Rolling back.
 2. Surrounding, screening.
 3. Rejection, exclusion, exception, Kumāras. 2, 27.
 4. Choice.
 5. Praise.

व्यास व्यास, i. e. वि- 2. अस् + अ, m.
 1. Extension, diffusion.
 2. Distinction, detail.
 3. A sage, the supposed compiler [] of the Vedas and Purāṇas, Lass. 49, 2; Chr. 45, 17.

व्यासङ्ग व्यासङ्ग, i. e. वि-आ-सञ्ज् + अ, m.
 1. Addition.
 2. Attachment, Bhartṛ. 1, 66; sitting on, Mālat. 153, 4.
 3. Separation, detachment.
 4. Perplexity, confusion, Lass. 2. ed. 67, 22.

व्याहार व्याहार, i. e. वि-आ-हृ + अ, m.
 1. Voice, a word, speech, Utt. Rāmac. 104, 5.
 2. Humorous speech, jest.

व्याहृति व्याहृति, i. e. वि-आ-हृ + ति, f.
 1. Voice, speech.
 2. A word.
 3. A mystical word, as ॐ, स्वर्, Man. 2, 78.
व्यञ्जन-स्थाने व्यञ्जन-स्थाने, loc. as condiment (करोमि, I shall use), Pañc. 52, 1.
